event: Tampa Bay Rays at Cleveland Guardians (ALCS Game 4)
reasoning: Tampa Bay is a 98-win team facing a must-win spot. It has a real starter in Nick Martinez (15-6, 3.10 ERA, rested eight days). Cleveland is expected to use Shawn Armstrong as an opener and then go to a bullpen game. The market has this as nearly a pick'em, so the home-team premium looks small, and the Rays' starting-pitching edge and 5-1 regular-season record against Cleveland aren't fully priced in. Cleveland's bullpen has been excellent and the Guardians lead the series 2-1, so this is a thin edge on a high-variance single game, not a strong lean.
